acceptanceCriteria: a run at normal load records the package's wall time and its slowest tests
either a hang is reproduced and fixed with a test, or the slow tests are identified and the suspicion is closed with the measurement
body: Observed by the load-flake lane (PR #942, base 945867cff) on darwin, 12 cores, go1.27.2: `go test -timeout 9m ./tools/corvint-pr-tests` in a combined run hit the timeout at 541 s at load ~50. Not rerun; not established whether a test hangs or the package is only slow. Expected: the package finishes well inside its budget. Suspected, not confirmed.
